output.message: I agree with Member_01’s assessment of the current versions. Maple’s calculation is incorrect: 54 ÷ 6 = 9 packs per team, not 12. Iris correctly calculates 117 ÷ 9 = 13, and Elm correctly calculates 54 ÷ 9 = 6. I downvoted Maple and upvoted Iris and Elm. My earlier comment concerned different numbers; these votes reflect the current posts.
